lines.t: In the quiet of the dawn, I feel you near
The voice that spoke before the earth's fear
From dust You formed man
And still Your mercy holds my hand
You are the light that breaks my night
The word that turns my darkness into light
Every promise tried and true
leads my heart to rest in You.
Yahushua, You are holy, King forever, Lord of glory.
In the pain, through the storm, You are peace, You are my song.
Yahushua, name above, endless truth, unending love.
Every heartbeat, all creation
Praises you in life's pulsation
Your word is fire, pure and clear
The still small voice that draws me near
You are the earth in humble grace
And bore my sin in love's embrace
The veil was torn, the stone rolled back
The shepherd calling, hearts are back
The lost are found, the blind now see
Your truth has set the captive free
Yahushua, you are holy, King forever, Lord of glory
In the pain, through the night, you are peace, you are my song
Yahushua, name above, endless truth, unending love
Every heartbeat, all creation, praises you in life's pulsation
All creation bows before the Lamb of God
Forevermore
He reigns in light
His Word endures
The heavens sing
Your kingdom comes
And I will lift my hands in praise
To the one who conquered the grave
My soul will sing through endless days
Your glory never fades away
Yahushua
You are holy
Keep forever
Lord of glory
In the pain
Through the hurt
You are peace
You are my song
Yahushua
Name above
Endless truth, unending love
Every heartbeat, all creation
Praises You in life's pulsation
Savior, light of the morning, rise again
Faithful friend who never ends
Till I stand before Your majesty
No more words, grip and agony
